scope: Estimator feasibility only; not algorithm superiority or a return guarantee for PPO/Adam
candidate_construction: Interpolate all actor parameters from pre-update policies to a fresh full-team sequential HAPPO update; reference is the full fresh HAPPO update. Optimizer states are not transported or overwritten. These frozen counterfactual policies are not a new optimizer.
confidence: Normal-SE scores are empirical qualification diagnostics only. No Gaussian assumption or sample range is substituted into a rigorous confidence theorem. Known-support simultaneous empirical Bernstein is audited separately.
decision: A pass qualifies a variance-sensitive observable score for a subsequent separately frozen confidence/controller study, not GPU performance work. Failure diagnoses variance, opportunity, precision and cost independently; no changes to these gates or seeds after outcomes.
accounting: Every common-path, replayed-prefix and branch suffix native joint transition is charged, including validation and replay separately. Policy forward rows, training actor/critic optimizer rows, and candidate parameter messages are recorded. No environment cost is saved by selecting a subset after sampling. First-disagreement requires resettable deterministic MPE dynamics; simulator access is explicit, not free sensing.
